brief:
# build-a-flutter-e-commerce-mvp-for-skin-care-tar

Build a Flutter e-commerce MVP for **Skin Care**. Target shoppers interested in this vertical. Example listing style: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash ($12.99). MVP must include: order history, promo codes at checkout, product reviews and star ratings, wishlist or favorites. Mobile-first UX, small releasable increment, demo-ready in one sprint.

product_brief.vision: Build a Flutter e-commerce MVP for Skin Care. Target shoppers interested in this vertical. Example listing style: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash ($12.99). MVP must include: order history, promo codes at checkout, product reviews and star ratings, wishlist or favorites. Mobile-first UX, small releasable increment, demo-ready in one sprint. Give everyday skincare shoppers a simple mobile store where they can browse trusted body and face care products, save favorites, leave reviews, apply promos at checkout, and see past orders—so we can start selling and learn what customers want before a bigger build.
target_users: Shoppers interested in the Skin Care vertical
Busy adults shopping for everyday body and face care (cleansers, body wash, moisturizers, similar to Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash at $12.99)
Repeat buyers who want order history, favorites, and promo savings on mobile
business_goals: Launch a demo-ready Skin Care mobile shopping MVP in one sprint
Validate demand for a mobile-first skincare storefront with a small releasable increment
Drive first purchases with promo codes at checkout
Build trust through product reviews and star ratings
Increase return visits via wishlist/favorites and order history
key_features: Flutter e-commerce MVP for Skin Care
Product listings in the style of Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash ($12.99)
constraints: Scope limited to Skin Care vertical for the MVP
open_questions: Exact brand name and visual identity for the storefront
Whether we sell only our own skincare line or curated third-party brands in MVP
Guest checkout vs account required before purchase
Payment methods for the demo (card only, wallet, or mock payment)
Shipping regions, rates, and free-shipping threshold
Return/refund policy shown in the app
How many SKUs and categories to seed for the sprint demo
Who can write reviews (verified buyers only or any signed-in user)
Promo code rules (percentage vs fixed amount, one code per order, stacking)
Push notifications and email receipts in or out of this sprint

clarifications.question: Exact brand name and visual identity for the storefront
clarifications.answer: Brand name: SoftAura. Visual identity: clean, calm mobile storefront with soft sage green (#7A9E8E) as the primary accent, warm ivory backgrounds, charcoal text, and rounded product imagery—simple and trustworthy, not clinical or luxury-heavy.

clarifications.question: Whether we sell only our own skincare line or curated third-party brands in MVP
clarifications.answer: Curated third-party everyday skincare brands for the MVP (body wash, cleansers, moisturizers in the Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash ~$12.99 style), so we can launch faster and validate demand before expanding into our own line.

clarifications.question: Shipping regions, rates, and free-shipping threshold
clarifications.answer: Ship to the contiguous United States only in this sprint. Flat rate $5.99 per order; free shipping on orders $35 and over. No international shipping in the MVP.

clarifications.question: Return/refund policy shown in the app
clarifications.answer: Show a simple policy in-app: unused, unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method; opened/used products are not returnable except if damaged or wrong item received. Customers start a return from Order History.

clarifications.question: How many SKUs and categories to seed for the sprint demo
clarifications.answer: Seed 24 SKUs across 4 categories: Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care. That is enough to browse, favorite, review, and checkout without bloating the one-sprint demo.

clarifications.question: Who can write reviews (verified buyers only or any signed-in user)
clarifications.answer: Verified buyers only—customers may leave a review and star rating after they have purchased that product, so ratings stay trustworthy.

clarifications.question: Promo code rules (percentage vs fixed amount, one code per order, stacking)
clarifications.answer: Support both percentage-off and fixed-amount codes. One promo code per order; no stacking. For the demo, seed WELCOME10 (10% off) and SAVE5 ($5 off), applied at checkout before tax and shipping.

clarifications.question: Push notifications and email receipts in or out of this sprint
clarifications.answer: Out of scope for push notifications this sprint. In scope: a simple order confirmation email receipt after a successful checkout (can be mocked/stubbed for the demo if full email delivery is not ready).

prd.title: SoftAura Skin Care Flutter E-Commerce MVP — M1 Speed Demo PRD
prd.summary: SoftAura is a Flutter Android-first skincare storefront for busy adults shopping everyday body and face care (curated third-party brands in the Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash ~$12.99 style). This M1 SPEED DEMO delivers the smallest runnable Flutter MVP with a local/mock catalog of 24 SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care so the app runs on an emulator immediately. Must-have screens: product list (browse) and product detail. Optional: simple in-memory cart. SoftAura visual identity: clean, calm UI with soft sage green (#7A9E8E) primary accent, warm ivory backgrounds, charcoal text, and rounded product imagery. Auth, payments, checkout, backend API, order history, promo codes, reviews, wishlist, and shipping are deferred after this sprint increment.

personas.name: Everyday Skincare Shopper
personas.description: Busy adult browsing SoftAura on Android for trusted everyday body and face care (cleansers, body wash, moisturizers) from curated third-party brands, wanting a calm mobile-first experience to discover products quickly without creating an account in this demo.
goals: Browse a focused Skin Care catalog by category and product name
Open a product detail page to see price, description, and imagery
Optionally add items to a simple in-memory cart to preview a shopping basket

user_stories.title: Browse SoftAura product catalog
user_stories.i_want: to see a scrollable list of SoftAura Skin Care products from a local mock catalog
user_stories.so_that: I can discover body and face care items on my phone without waiting for a backend

acceptance_criteria.given: the SoftAura Flutter app is launched on an Android emulator with the seeded mock catalog of 24 SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care
acceptance_criteria.when: I open the product list (browse) screen
acceptance_criteria.then: I see product cards showing at least product name, price displayed from integer minor units (cents) with ISO 4217 currency code USD (e.g. 1299 cents as $12.99), and rounded product imagery on a warm ivory background with sage green (#7A9E8E) accent and charcoal text

acceptance_criteria.given: the product list screen is displayed with the mock catalog loaded
acceptance_criteria.then: all seeded products remain reachable and the list does not crash or show empty placeholders for valid catalog entries

acceptance_criteria.given: the mock catalog includes products in multiple categories
acceptance_criteria.then: each listed product is associated with one of Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, or Face Care so a QA engineer can verify category membership against seed data

user_stories.title: View product detail
user_stories.i_want: to open a product detail screen from the browse list
user_stories.so_that: I can read name, price, description, and see imagery before deciding to buy later

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the SoftAura product list screen with at least one product visible
acceptance_criteria.then: I navigate to the product detail screen for that product and see name, price from integer cents with USD, category, description, and rounded product image using SoftAura styling (sage #7A9E8E accent, warm ivory, charcoal text)

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on a product detail screen
acceptance_criteria.then: I return to the product list screen with the catalog still visible

acceptance_criteria.given: a product in the mock catalog has unit price 1299 cents USD (e.g. Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style listing)
acceptance_criteria.when: I open that product’s detail screen
acceptance_criteria.then: the displayed price equals $12.99 and is not rendered from a floating-point money value

user_stories.title: Optional in-memory cart
user_stories.i_want: to add a product from detail into a simple in-memory cart
user_stories.so_that: I can preview selected items in this demo without auth or checkout

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on a product detail screen and the optional in-memory cart is implemented
acceptance_criteria.then: the product is added to an in-memory cart (session only) and I can see the cart contains that product with name and unit price copied at add time

acceptance_criteria.given: the in-memory cart already contains one or more items
acceptance_criteria.when: I leave the cart screen and return, or navigate between list and detail within the same app session
acceptance_criteria.then: cart contents remain until the app process is killed; no persistence, auth, payment, or backend sync is required

non_functional_requirements: Android-first Flutter 3.x app; MVP must launch and run on an Android emulator without a live backend API for catalog data.
Product catalog for M1 is local/mock seed data (24 SKUs, 4 categories); prices stored and handled as integer minor units (cents) with ISO 4217 currency code USD—never floats.

SoftAura visual tokens may be chosen by the implementer without stakeholder style approval: primary accent #7A9E8E, warm ivory backgrounds, charcoal text, rounded product imagery; calm and trustworthy, not clinical or luxury-heavy.
At most 3 app screens in M1 (product list, product detail, optional cart). At most 1 milestone. Prefer starting coding in the first build items.

If any API surface exists in M1, at most 4 business API operations; infrastructure endpoints /health and /api/docs-json do not count toward that limit and health check must be included in the contract when a backend stub exists—otherwise no backend work if it slows delivery.
Performance: product list and detail should become interactive within a few seconds of cold start on a standard emulator using local mock data.
Accessibility: text contrast sufficient for charcoal on ivory; tappable targets large enough for mobile; screen navigation usable with standard Android back behavior.
Privacy/security for M1: no account, no passwords, no card data, no PII collection required; do not send catalog or cart data to external payment providers in this increment.
Testing: flutter_test coverage for price formatting (cents → display) and navigation from list to detail; optional widget/integration smoke test that the app starts and shows the browse screen.
out_of_scope: User authentication, registration, JWT sessions, and guest vs signed-in carts
Stripe PaymentIntents, payments, checkout, tax calculation, and order fulfilment
Order history, order status flow, returns/refunds initiation, and email receipts
Promo codes (WELCOME10, SAVE5) and stacking rules
Product reviews, star ratings, and verified-buyer review gating
Backend NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL catalog API work if it delays the Flutter emulator demo
International shipping; contiguous US shipping rates and free-shipping threshold enforcement
Account deletion and password hashing (no accounts in M1)
iOS release as a primary delivery target for this sprint
Human approval, stakeholder sign-off, or style-approval work items
assumptions: Brand name SoftAura and visual identity tokens (#7A9E8E sage, warm ivory, charcoal, rounded imagery) are fixed for implementation without further brand approval gates.
M1 catalog is curated third-party everyday skincare seed data: 24 SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care, including listings in the ~$12.99 body wash style.
Scope-for-this-run SPEED DEMO rules override fuller SoftAura PRD ambitions: max 3 user stories, max 5 work items, max 1 milestone, max 4 API operations, max 3 app screens.
In-memory cart is optional; product list and product detail alone satisfy the M1 must-have demo journey.

Later releases may add signed-in carts, Stripe test-mode payments, promo codes, verified-buyer reviews, wishlist, order history, US flat $5.99 shipping / free over $35, and the 30-day unused-unopened return policy—none of which block M1.
Currency for seeded prices is USD; all money values use integer cents.

architecture.overview: SoftAura Skin Care M1 Speed Demo delivers a Flutter 3.x Android-first mobile app that browses a locally embedded mock catalog of 24 skincare SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care (curated third-party brands in the Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash ~$12.99 / 1299 cents USD style), shows product detail with name, price, category, description, and rounded imagery, and supports an optional in-memory cart that clears on process restart. No backend, auth, payments, or checkout ship in M1—the app must launch on an Android emulator with mock data immediately. SoftAura visual tokens are fixed for implementation without approval gates: primary accent #7A9E8E (sage), warm ivory backgrounds, charcoal text, rounded product imagery. This document freezes the production-ready target architecture (NestJS + PostgreSQL 16 + Stripe) and a minimal OpenAPI 3.1 contract (health plus two catalog reads) so later milestones implement against an exact API and data model without guessing. Prices are integer USD cents with ISO 4217 currency; stock is per variant.

components.name: Flutter Mobile App (M1 primary)
components.responsibility: Renders product list (browse), product detail, and optional in-memory cart. Embeds seeded SoftAura mock catalog of 24 SKUs for M1. Handles loading, empty, and error states; category association visible on list cards. SoftAura theme from design tokens (sage #7A9E8E, warm ivory, charcoal). Preserves list scroll/context when navigating back from detail. Post-M1 switches to generated OpenAPI client (dart-dio) against NestJS.
components.technology: Flutter 3.x, Dart, Riverpod (Notifier/AsyncNotifier), go_router, freezed/json_serializable, flutter_secure_storage (M2+), flutter_test, integration_test

components.name: Local Mock Catalog (M1)
components.responsibility: Provides exactly 24 skincare SKUs across Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care with name, brand, category, priceCents, currency USD, rounded image asset, description, and default-variant stock. Must include an Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style listing at 1299 cents USD. Source of truth for M1 browse/detail/cart; shapes mirror OpenAPI ProductSummary/ProductDetail for an easy M2 swap.
components.technology: assets/data/catalog.json, bundled image assets, Dart freezed models

components.name: NestJS API Server (M2+)
components.responsibility: Contract-first REST API under global prefix /api/v1. Thin controllers, service-layer logic, PrismaService for data access. Catalog read endpoints first; auth, cart, orders, payments modules added after M1. DTOs use class-validator; responses match OpenAPI exactly.

components.name: PostgreSQL Database (M2+)
components.responsibility: System of record for users, catalog, carts, orders, and payment metadata. ACID transactions for stock reservation at checkout and order creation.

components.name: Stripe (later release)
components.responsibility: PaymentIntents in test mode; server creates intent, app confirms via Stripe SDK, webhook marks order paid. Card data never touches SoftAura servers.
components.technology: Stripe API, Stripe Flutter SDK, webhook signing secret

components.name: Docker / CI (M2+)
components.responsibility: docker-compose for local/staging (API + Postgres). GitHub Actions runs lint, unit, and e2e tests on PR.

backend_modules.name: health
backend_modules.responsibility: Liveness and database connectivity probe. Included in M1 OpenAPI contract; NestJS implementation deferred until backend work starts (does not block Flutter M1). Does not count toward the four API-operation cap.

backend_modules.name: catalog
backend_modules.responsibility: Public read-only SoftAura skincare catalog for browse and detail. Supports pagination, text search, and category filter (Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, Face Care). Product detail includes brand, description, category, and variants with per-variant price and stock. M1 Flutter uses local mock shaped like these responses; NestJS implements these two operations first in M2.

backend_modules.name: auth (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Email/password registration and login, JWT access (15 min) and refresh tokens, account deletion. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: users (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Profile and saved shipping addresses for checkout. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: cart (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Signed-in user cart persisted server-side. M1 uses in-memory CartNotifier only; guest carts out of scope until a later release that explicitly requires guest checkout. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: orders (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Order placement and history with status lifecycle pending_payment → paid → fulfilled → delivered, plus cancelled and refunded. Order lines snapshot product name and unit price. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

backend_modules.name: payments (deferred post-M1)
backend_modules.responsibility: Stripe PaymentIntents and webhooks; card data never on server. Out of M1 OpenAPI scope.

app_features.name: catalog
screens: ProductListScreen (/products) — scrollable SoftAura product cards with name, formatted price from integer cents + USD (e.g. Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style as $12.99 from 1299 cents), rounded product imagery, category membership (Body Wash | Cleansers | Moisturizers | Face Care); warm ivory background, sage #7A9E8E accent, charcoal text; loading, empty, and error/retry states; all 24 seeded SKUs reachable by scroll

ProductDetailScreen (/products/:id) — name, brand, category, unit price (cents + USD), description, rounded product image; SoftAura styling; optional Add to cart (≥48dp); Android back returns to list with catalog still visible
app_features.state_management: CatalogRepository (M1: LocalCatalogDataSource from assets/data/catalog.json; M2+: generated CatalogApi). ProductListNotifier (AsyncNotifier) holds AsyncValue of the 24 products. ProductDetailNotifier loads one product by id. Price formatting helpers convert cents → display string without floats.

app_features.name: cart
screens: CartScreen (/cart) — optional M1; line items with product name and unit price snapshot (cents + currency) copied at add time; session-only until process kill
app_features.state_management: CartNotifier (Notifier<CartState>) session-only in-memory for M1; clears on full process restart. Add from ProductDetailScreen. No persistence, auth, payment, or backend sync in M1.

app_features.name: core
app_features.state_management: Design tokens in lib/core/theme: primary #7A9E8E, warm ivory background, charcoal text, rounded imagery radii—chosen without style-approval gates; go_router routes /products, /products/:id, /cart; no live HTTP in M1 debug builds (offline mock). Debug Android cleartext only for 10.0.2.2 when backend arrives.

architecture.data_model_notes: All monetary amounts are Int minor units (cents) with ISO 4217 currency code USD; never floats. Product is the merchandising parent (skincare listing with brand and category); ProductVariant is the purchasable SKU with its own priceCents, currency, and stockQuantity (and reservedQuantity for M2+ checkout holds). Listing cards show display price from the default or lowest active variant. Category is one of Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, Face Care (seeded as four Category rows; M1 mock associates each of 24 SKUs to exactly one). Flagship seed: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style listing at 1299 cents USD displayed as $12.99. CartItem and OrderItem snapshot productName and unitPriceCents at write time so later catalog edits do not alter past carts/orders. Order.status: pending_payment → paid → fulfilled → delivered, plus cancelled and refunded. Stock reservation at checkout (M2+); failed or expired payment releases reserved stock. User.passwordHash uses bcrypt or argon2; support account deletion with PII removal/anonymization. M1 runtime uses only embedded mock catalog JSON—no Prisma/Postgres connection.
security: M1 ships no auth, no mandatory network calls, and no PII, passwords, or payment data—mock catalog is read-only embedded data; do not send catalog or cart data to external payment providers in this increment.
M2+ JWT bearer auth: access tokens 15-minute TTL, refresh tokens rotated and stored hashed server-side; flutter_secure_storage on mobile.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (cost ≥12) or argon2id; never store plaintext.
All API input validated via class-validator DTOs; responses match OpenAPI schemas exactly; errors return { statusCode, error, message }.
Stripe webhook verifies Stripe-Signature; idempotent event handling; card PAN/CVC never touch SoftAura servers.
HTTPS-only in release mobile builds; debug Android allows cleartext to 10.0.2.2 only via network_security_config.
Config and secrets via environment variables validated at NestJS startup (@nestjs/config)—never committed.
Minimum personal data collection; account deletion removes or anonymizes PII.
Catalog and health endpoints are public (security: []); bearerAuth scheme is declared for future protected modules.

adrs.title: Local embedded mock catalog for SoftAura M1 Speed Demo
adrs.context: PRD requires the smallest runnable Flutter MVP on an Android emulator immediately with 24 skincare SKUs across four categories. NestJS, Postgres, generated clients, and CI would delay the demo. US-001/US-002/US-003 need browse, detail, and optional session cart only—no auth, payments, or checkout. Backend work is explicitly deferred if it slows delivery.
adrs.decision: M1 loads 24 SoftAura Skin Care SKUs from assets (catalog.json + rounded image assets), including an Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style listing at 1299 cents USD. Category membership and price formatting run in-process. No HTTP client is required in M1 builds. CatalogRepository abstracts the data source so M2 can swap to the generated OpenAPI client without rewriting screens.
adrs.consequences: Positive—offline demo, zero backend dependency, fastest path to validating SoftAura browse/detail UX. Negative—cart is session-only; no shared stock truth; M2 must migrate to API and keep server as source of truth for catalog and inventory.

adrs.title: Integer minor units for all money fields
adrs.context: Floating-point money causes rounding errors in totals and Stripe amounts. Project rules forbid floats for prices. Demo must show $12.99 from 1299 cents exactly for the body-wash style flagship listing.
adrs.decision: Store and transmit all prices as integer cents with currency code USD (ISO 4217). Flutter, NestJS, Prisma Int, and OpenAPI integer schemas agree. Formatting to display strings (e.g. $12.99) happens only in the presentation layer; flutter_test covers cents → display.
adrs.consequences: Positive—exact arithmetic, Stripe-compatible amounts, consistent contract. Negative—UI must use format helpers; developers must never use double for money.

adrs.title: Contract-first OpenAPI 3.1 capped to M1 catalog operations
adrs.context: Mobile convention requires a dart-dio client generated from OpenAPI. Hard scope limits this run to at most four API operations. Cart is in-memory and needs no API. Auth, payments, and checkout are out of scope. M1 prefers zero live business API dependency.
adrs.decision: Freeze OpenAPI 3.1 with GET /health (infra, uncapped), GET /products (search, category filter, pagination), and GET /products/{productId}. Bearer auth is declared for M2+ but unused by these public operations. NestJS will implement controllers to match; Flutter generates packages/api_client when the backend ships. SoftAura visual tokens (#7A9E8E sage, warm ivory, charcoal) are fixed in the Flutter theme layer without stakeholder style approval.
adrs.consequences: Positive—parallel M2 catalog work without over-building; mock models mirror schemas; generated types reduce drift; no approval gates block coding. Negative—later milestones must extend the same OpenAPI carefully; M1 cannot exercise a live API until NestJS exists.

architecture.openapi_yaml:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SoftAura Skin Care API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    SoftAura Skin Care e-commerce API contract for the M1 Speed Demo and later milestones.
    M1 Flutter app uses local mock data only and does not call this API.
    This document covers must-have catalog stories (US-001 browse, US-002 detail):
    health probe plus two public catalog read operations. Cart is in-memory on
    the client in M1 (US-003 optional) and has no API operations here. Auth, payments,
    checkout, and orders are deferred.
  contact:
    name: SoftAura Engineering
servers:
  - url: http://10.0.2.2:3000/api/v1
    description: Android emulator → local staging
  - url: https://api.staging.softaura.example/api/v1
    description: Staging
  - url: https://api.softaura.example/api/v1
    description: Production
tags:
  - name: Health
    description: Service health checks
  - name: Catalog
    description: SoftAura skincare product browse and detail (public)
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags:
        - Health
      operationId: getHealth
      summary: Health check
      description: Returns 200 when the service and database are reachable.
      security: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/HealthResponse'
        '503':
          description: Service unavailable (database unreachable)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /products:
    get:
      tags:
        - Catalog
      operationId: listProducts
      summary: List SoftAura skincare products
      description: |
        Paginated product listing with optional category filter and search.
        Supports US-001 browse requirements for 24 SKUs across Body Wash,
        Cleansers, Moisturizers, and Face Care. Public endpoint; no authentication required.
        Prices are integer minor units with ISO 4217 currency USD.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Page'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PageSize'
        - name: q
          in: query
          description: Case-insensitive search against product name, brand, and description
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 100
            example: Olay
        - name: category
          in: query
          description: Filter by SoftAura skincare category
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/SkinCareCategorySlug'
        - name: minPriceCents
          in: query
          description: Minimum display price in USD cents (inclusive)
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            example: 999
        - name: maxPriceCents
          in: query
          description: Maximum display price in USD cents (inclusive)
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            example: 2999
        - name: sort
          in: query
          description: Sort order for results
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - priceAsc
              - priceDesc
              - nameAsc
              - newest
            default: newest
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paginated product list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductListResponse'
        '400':
          description: Invalid query parameters
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /products/{productId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - Catalog
      operationId: getProductById
      summary: Get SoftAura product detail
      description: |
        Returns full product detail including brand, category, description, and active variants
        with per-variant stock. Supports US-002. Public endpoint. Body-wash style flagship
        (Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash style) must return price 1299 cents USD.
      security: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProductId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Product detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductDetail'
        '404':
          description: Product not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: |
        JWT access token (15-minute TTL). Declared for M2+ protected endpoints.
        Catalog and health operations in this document do not require a bearer token.
  parameters:
    Page:
      name: page
      in: query
      description: 1-based page number
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        default: 1
    PageSize:
      name: pageSize
      in: query
      description: Items per page
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 24
    ProductId:
      name: productId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Product UUID
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
  schemas:
    HealthResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - status
        - database
        - timestamp
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - ok
            - degraded
        database:
          type: string
          enum:
            - up
            - down
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - statusCode
        - error
        - message
      properties:
        statusCode:
          type: integer
          example: 400
        error:
          type: string
          example: Bad Request
        message:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: array
              items:
                type: string
          example: Invalid query parameter pageSize
    Money:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - amountCents
        - currency
      properties:
        amountCents:
          type: integer
          description: Amount in minor units (cents)
          minimum: 0
          example: 1299
        currency:
          type: string
          description: ISO 4217 currency code
          pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$'
          example: USD
    SkinCareCategorySlug:
      type: string
      description: SoftAura M1 skincare category slug used for browse filters
      enum:
        - body-wash
        - cleansers
        - moisturizers
        - face-care
    Category:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - slug
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
          example: Body Wash
        slug:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/SkinCareCategorySlug'
    ProductSummary:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - brand
        - category
        - price
        - primaryImageUrl
        - inStock
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
          example: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash
        brand:
          type: string
          description: Curated third-party brand name
          example: Olay
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          allOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
          description: Display price (default or lowest active variant); 1299 cents USD for flagship body wash style
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Rounded product imagery URL or asset URI
        inStock:
          type: boolean
          description: True when at least one active variant has stockQuantity > 0
    ProductListResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - items
        - total
        - page
        - pageSize
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        total:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Total matching products (24 for full unfiltered M1 seed)
        page:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
        pageSize:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
    ProductVariant:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - sku
        - name
        - price
        - stockQuantity
        - isDefault
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        sku:
          type: string
          example: SA-OLAY-BW-SHEA-650
        name:
          type: string
          description: Variant label (e.g. size/volume)
          example: 650 mL
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        stockQuantity:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
          description: Available stock for this variant (static in M1 mock)
        imageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        isDefault:
          type: boolean
          description: Default variant used for list/detail price and availability
    ProductDetail:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - brand
        - description
        - category
        - price
        - primaryImageUrl
        - inStock
        - variants
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
          example: Olay Ultra Moisture Shea Butter Body Wash
        brand:
          type: string
          example: Olay
        description:
          type: string
          description: Longer listing copy for the SoftAura product detail screen
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          allOf:
            - $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
          description: Display price from default variant (1299 cents USD for body-wash style flagship)
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        inStock:
          type: boolean
        variants:
          type: array

          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductVariant'
architecture.prisma_schema:
// SoftAura Skin Care — PostgreSQL 16 schema (Prisma)
// M1 mobile app does NOT connect to this database; seeded for M2+ backend.

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum OrderStatus {
  pending_payment
  paid
  fulfilled
  delivered
  cancelled
  refunded
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  requires_payment_method
  requires_confirmation
  requires_action
  processing
  succeeded
  canceled
  failed
}

enum AddressLabel {
  home
  work
  other
}

model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email        String    @unique @db.VarChar(255)
  passwordHash String?   @map("password_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  displayName  String?   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  deletedAt    DateTime? @map("deleted_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  refreshTokens RefreshToken[]
  addresses     Address[]
  cart          Cart?
  orders        Order[]

  @@map("users")
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  tokenHash String    @map("token_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  expiresAt DateTime  @map("expires_at") @db.Timestamptz
  revokedAt DateTime? @map("revoked_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("refresh_tokens")
}

model Address {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId     String       @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  label      AddressLabel @default(home)
  fullName   String       @map("full_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  line1      String       @db.VarChar(200)
  line2      String?      @db.VarChar(200)
  city       String       @db.VarChar(100)
  region     String       @db.VarChar(100)
  postalCode String       @map("postal_code") @db.VarChar(20)
  country    String       @default("US") @db.VarChar(2)
  isDefault  Boolean      @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt  DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user   User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  orders Order[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("addresses")
}

model Category {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name      String   @db.VarChar(100)
  slug      String   @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  sortOrder Int      @default(0) @map("sort_order")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  products Product[]

  @@map("categories")
}

model Product {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  categoryId      String   @map("category_id") @db.Uuid
  name            String   @db.VarChar(200)
  slug            String   @unique @db.VarChar(200)
  brand           String   @db.VarChar(100)
  description     String   @db.Text
  primaryImageUrl String   @map("primary_image_url") @db.VarChar(500)
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  category Category         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  variants ProductVariant[]

  @@index([categoryId])
  @@index([brand])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@map("products")
}

model ProductVariant {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  productId        String   @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  sku              String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  name             String   @db.VarChar(120)
  priceCents       Int      @map("price_cents")
  currency         String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  stockQuantity    Int      @default(0) @map("stock_quantity")
  reservedQuantity Int      @default(0) @map("reserved_quantity")
  imageUrl         String?  @map("image_url") @db.VarChar(500)
  isDefault        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  isActive         Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  product    Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  cartItems  CartItem[]
  orderItems OrderItem[]

  @@index([productId])
  @@map("product_variants")
}

model Cart {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String   @unique @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user  User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

model CartItem {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  cartId         String   @map("cart_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId      String   @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  quantity       Int      @default(1)
  unitPriceCents Int      @map("unit_price_cents")
  currency       String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  productName    String   @map("product_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  variantName    String   @map("variant_name") @db.VarChar(120)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  cart    Cart           @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@unique([cartId, variantId])
  @@index([cartId])
  @@map("cart_items")
}

model Order {
  id                      String      @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId                  String      @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  status                  OrderStatus @default(pending_payment)
  currency                String      @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  subtotalCents           Int         @map("subtotal_cents")
  shippingCents           Int         @default(0) @map("shipping_cents")
  taxCents                Int         @default(0) @map("tax_cents")
  totalCents              Int         @map("total_cents")
  shippingAddressId       String?     @map("shipping_address_id") @db.Uuid
  shippingAddressSnapshot Json?       @map("shipping_address_snapshot")
  stripePaymentIntentId   String?     @unique @map("stripe_payment_intent_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  paidAt                  DateTime?   @map("paid_at") @db.Timestamptz
  fulfilledAt             DateTime?   @map("fulfilled_at") @db.Timestamptz
  deliveredAt             DateTime?   @map("delivered_at") @db.Timestamptz
  cancelledAt             DateTime?   @map("cancelled_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt               DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt               DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user            User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  shippingAddress Address?    @relation(fields: [shippingAddressId], references: [id])
  items           OrderItem[]
  payment         Payment?

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderItem {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId        String   @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId      String?  @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  productName    String   @map("product_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  variantName    String   @map("variant_name") @db.VarChar(120)
  sku            String   @db.VarChar(64)
  quantity       Int
  unitPriceCents Int      @map("unit_price_cents")
  currency       String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  lineTotalCents Int      @map("line_total_cents")
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  order   Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model Payment {
  id                    String        @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId               String        @unique @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  stripePaymentIntentId String        @unique @map("stripe_payment_intent_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  status                PaymentStatus
  amountCents           Int           @map("amount_cents")
  currency              String        @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  stripeEventId         String?       @unique @map("stripe_event_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  createdAt             DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt             DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  order Order @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("payments")
}

shared_widgets.name: SoftAuraAppBar
shared_widgets.description: Top app bar with SoftAura brand title or screen title, charcoal text on warm ivory (dark: light text on surface), optional trailing cart icon button with ≥48dp hit area and semantic label Cart.

shared_widgets.name: ProductCard
shared_widgets.description: Browse list card showing rounded product image (radius 16), product name (title), formatted USD price from integer cents (e.g. 1299 → $12.99), and category chip (Body Wash | Cleansers | Moisturizers | Face Care). Entire card tappable ≥48dp tall; sage accent on chip/border; Semantics label includes name, category, and price.

shared_widgets.name: ProductImage
shared_widgets.description: Rounded product imagery (corner radius 16–24) with warm ivory/surface_variant placeholder, BoxFit.cover, and required semanticLabel describing the product.

shared_widgets.name: PriceText
shared_widgets.description: Displays money from integer minor units (cents) + ISO 4217 USD as $X.XX without floating-point arithmetic; uses price type style and charcoal/primary contrast.

shared_widgets.name: CategoryChip
shared_widgets.description: Compact label for one of Body Wash, Cleansers, Moisturizers, Face Care; sage primary fill or outline on ivory; min height 32 with parent ensuring 48dp touch if interactive.

shared_widgets.name: PrimaryButton
shared_widgets.description: Filled sage (#7A9E8E) button with text_on_primary label, min height/width 48dp, used for Add to cart and Retry actions.

shared_widgets.name: LoadingStateView
shared_widgets.description: Centered CircularProgressIndicator using primary accent with optional caption Loading SoftAura products; used while AsyncValue is loading.

shared_widgets.name: EmptyStateView
shared_widgets.description: Centered illustration/placeholder, headline and body copy when catalog or cart has zero items, optional PrimaryButton CTA.

shared_widgets.name: ErrorStateView
shared_widgets.description: Error message with Retry PrimaryButton (≥48dp); shown when catalog load fails; charcoal text on ivory, error color for icon.

shared_widgets.name: CartLineItem
shared_widgets.description: Cart row with product name and unit price snapshot (cents + USD copied at add time); 48dp min row height; Semantics for name and price.

screens.name: ProductListScreen
screens.purpose: Scrollable SoftAura Skin Care browse screen showing all 24 seeded mock SKUs as product cards with name, USD price from integer cents, rounded imagery, and category membership on warm ivory with sage accent and charcoal text.

screens.name: ProductDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Product detail for a single catalog SKU: name, brand, category, unit price (cents → $X.XX USD), description, and rounded product image with SoftAura styling; optional Add to cart (≥48dp); Android back returns to list with catalog still visible.

screens.name: CartScreen
screens.purpose: Optional M1 in-memory session cart listing line items with product name and unit price snapshot (cents + USD) copied at add time; contents survive list/detail navigation within the same process and clear on process kill; no auth, payment, or persistence.

navigation.trigger: Android system back or AppBar back → pop to /products with catalog state retained
Tap AppBar cart icon → go_router push /cart
Tap AppBar cart icon or after Add to cart feedback → go_router push /cart
Android system back or AppBar back → pop; cart Notifier state remains for session

accessibility: All interactive controls meet minimum 48×48 dp touch targets (ProductCard, PrimaryButton, AppBar back/cart icons, Retry).
Charcoal text (#2C2C2C) on warm ivory (#F7F3EB) and light text (#F2EDE4) on dark surface (#2A2E2B) meet WCAG AA contrast (≥4.5:1 for body text).
Sage primary (#7A9E8E) on white/ivory button label uses text_on_primary (#FFFFFF) meeting AA for large/button text.
Every ProductImage and icon includes a non-empty Semantics / semanticLabel (product name or action, e.g. Add to cart, Go back, Open cart).
PriceText announces formatted currency (e.g. 12 dollars 99 cents) via Semantics, never raw cents alone.
ProductCard Semantics merges name, category, and price into one focusable announcement.
Navigation supports standard Android back behavior from detail and cart to prior screen without trapping focus.
Loading, empty, and error states expose liveRegion / Semantics announcements so screen readers hear status changes.
CategoryChip text remains readable at 14sp with sufficient contrast against sage outline or soft sage fill.
Do not rely on color alone: category chips include text labels; error state includes icon plus Retry label.
